Move the slider to compare visits during successive training windows. Colors use the same logarithmic scale throughout; hover over a visited tile for its map, local coordinates and exact count.

<iframe src="heatmap-view.html" title="Kanto exploration by training window" style="width:100%;height:980px;border:0;"></iframe>

The forest and gym are shown separately from the 37 connected mainland maps. Each frame reports visits to areas outside these panels. Synthetic runs are demonstrations, not training results; their walkers do not obey the game's collision rules.

## Recorded progress by seed

Each marker shows the first sampled observation at or beyond a progress stage. Hover for the stages and logged training step. A first-sample marker may represent progress inherited from a saved state; it does not establish when the agent earned it.

<iframe src="milestone-timeline.html" title="First recorded progress by seed" style="width:100%;height:720px;border:0;"></iframe>

The progress counter records the furthest stage, so reaching a later stage does not prove every earlier event occurred. Missing markers mean the threshold was not observed in sampled logs.
